title: NLPMetricLab: Multilingual NLP Metric Evaluation Toolkit (v1.0)
description: Companion evaluation system for the study 'Paradox of Poetic Intent in Back-Translation'. Provides interactive computation of BLEU, CHRF, TER, and Semantic Similarity on paired texts with native Chinese support (Han detection, Jieba tokenization). Published as a Streamlit web application.
